obligations.ask: Return confirmation that water account details are correct

results.segment: Confirmation that the water account details are correct must be returned within 42 days of the date of this letter.
The water account is being checked by the department that holds it, and any correction is applied automatically within 30 days.
This part of the letter is sent for information only.
You may keep this letter for your records; a copy is also held on your file.
